type {AIProvider, MessageChunk, ToolCall} from '../../types/ai.js';\nimport {AIError} from '../../types/ai.js';\nimport type {ChatSession, SessionEntry} from '../../types/session.js';\nimport type {OutgoingMessage} from '../../types/messages.js';\nimport {PerSessionLock} from '../../shared/perSessionLock.js';\nimport {deferred} from '../wsTestSupport.js';\nimport {InMemorySessionStore} from '../../infrastructure/stores/inMemorySessionStore.js';\n\n// The frames, in order, are the contract - above all for suppression, which retracts.\n\n// One line per frame; entries carry generated timestamps no assertion should read.\nconst wire = (sent: OutgoingMessage[]): string[] =>\n  sent.map(frame => {\n    if (frame.type === 'entry_upsert') {\n      const content = 'content' in frame.entry ? frame.entry.content : '';\n      return `upsert ${frame.index} ${frame.entry.role} ${JSON.stringify(content)}`;\n    }\n    if (frame.type === 'entry_delta') return `delta ${frame.index} ${JSON.stringify(frame.delta)}`;\n    if (frame.type === 'entry_commit') return `commit ${frame.index}`;\n    if (frame.type === 'entry_skip') return `skip ${frame.index}`;\n    if (frame.type === 'error') return `error ${frame.code}`;\n    if (frame.type === 'pong') return `pong ${frame.timestamp}`;\n    return frame.type;\n  });\n\nconst text = (value: string): MessageChunk => ({type: 'text', text: value});\nconst STOP: MessageChunk = {type: 'stop', stopReason: 'end_turn'};\nconst SUPPRESS = {type: 'suppress_output'} as unknown as MessageChunk;\n\ninterface StreamScript {\n  failWith?: Error;\n  pauseAfter?: {chunks: number; until: Promise<void>};\n}\n\nconst harness = (chunks: MessageChunk[], {failWith, pauseAfter}: StreamScript = {}) => {\n  const sent: OutgoingMessage[] = [];\n  const ws = {send: (raw: string) => sent.push(JSON.parse(raw) as OutgoingMessage)} as unknown as WebSocket;\n\n  const stream = async function* (): AsyncGenerator<MessageChunk> {\n    for (const [position, chunk] of chunks.entries()) {\n      if (pauseAfter && position === pauseAfter.chunks) await pauseAfter.until;\n      yield chunk;\n    }\n    if (failWith) throw failWith;\n  };\n\n  const processMessageStream = jest.fn(stream);\n  const orchestrator = {processMessageStream} as unknown as ChatOrchestrator;\n  const session: ChatSession = {sessionId: 's1', userId: 'u1', entries: []};\n\n  const handle = createMessageHandler(orchestrator);\n\n  return {\n    session,\n    processMessageStream,\n    sent,\n    frames: () => wire(sent),\n    send: (raw: unknown = {type: 'user_message', content: 'hello'}, signal?: AbortSignal) =>\n      handle(ws, session, raw, signal),\n  };\n};\n\ndescribe('the websocket message handler', () => {\n  describe('dispatch', () => {\n    it('rejects an unparseable message and never starts a stream', async () => {\n      const h = harness([]);\n\n      await h.send({type: 'nonsense'});\n\n      const {calls} = h.processMessageStream.mock;\n\n      expect({frames: h.frames(), streams: calls.length}).toEqual({frames: ['error INVALID_MESSAGE'], streams: 0});\n    });\n\n    it('answers a ping with the timestamp it was given', async () => {\n      const h = harness([]);\n\n      await h.send({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1234});\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual(['pong 1234']);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('a plain assistant reply', () => {\n    it('sends the user entry, then the assistant entry, its delta, its commit and stream_end', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('hi there'), STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual([\n        'upsert 0 user \"hello\"',\n        'upsert 1 assistant \"\"',\n        'delta 1 \"hi there\"',\n        'commit 1',\n        'stream_end',\n      ]);\n    });\n\n    it('leaves the committed assistant entry in the session, no longer streaming', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('hi there'), STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      const {entries} = h.session;\n\n      expect(entries[1]).toMatchObject({role: 'assistant', content: 'hi there', isStreaming: false});\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('thinking segments', () => {\n    it('commits the thinking entry before the assistant entry opens', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('<thinking>pondering</thinking>answer'), STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual([\n        'upsert 0 user \"hello\"',\n        'upsert 1 thinking \"\"',\n        'delta 1 \"pondering\"',\n        'commit 1',\n        'upsert 2 assistant \"\"',\n        'delta 2 \"answer\"',\n        'commit 2',\n        'stream_end',\n      ]);\n    });\n\n    it('commits the thinking entry when text resumes, not when a tool entry appears', async () => {\n      const h = harness([\n        text('<thinking>I should look up the weather for Berlin.</thinking>'),\n        {type: 'tool_use', toolCall: {id: 'c1', name: 'get_weather', input: {location: 'Berlin'}}} as MessageChunk,\n        text('Berlin currently has '),\n        text('a temperature of 18 degrees Celsius with clear skies.'),\n        STOP,\n      ]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual([\n        'upsert 0 user \"hello\"',\n        'upsert 1 thinking \"\"',\n        'delta 1 \"I should look up the weather for Berlin.\"',\n        'upsert 2 tool \"\"',\n        'commit 1',\n        'upsert 3 assistant \"\"',\n        'delta 3 \"Berlin currently has \"',\n        'delta 3 \"a temperature of 18 degrees Celsius with clear skies.\"',\n        'commit 3',\n        'stream_end',\n      ]);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('tool chunks', () => {\n    it('sends a tool entry for a tool call', async () => {\n      const h = harness([{type: 'tool_use', toolCall: {id: 'c1', name: 'lookup', input: {q: 1}}}, STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual(['upsert 0 user \"hello\"', 'upsert 1 tool \"\"', 'stream_end']);\n    });\n\n    it('forwards a tool result to the client untouched', async () => {\n      const forwarded = {type: 'entry_commit', index: 41} as OutgoingMessage;\n      const h = harness([{type: 'tool_result', clientMessages: [forwarded]} as MessageChunk, STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual(['upsert 0 user \"hello\"', 'commit 41', 'stream_end']);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('suppression', () => {\n    it('blanks an assistant entry that was already sent', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('leaked'), STOP, SUPPRESS]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual([\n        'upsert 0 user \"hello\"',\n        'upsert 1 assistant \"\"',\n        'delta 1 \"leaked\"',\n        'commit 1',\n        'upsert 1 assistant \"\"',\n        'stream_end',\n      ]);\n    });\n\n    it('never blanks a thinking entry, only assistant ones', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('<thinking>private</thinking>said'), STOP, SUPPRESS]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames().filter(frame => frame.startsWith('upsert 1'))).toEqual(['upsert 1 thinking \"\"']);\n    });\n\n    it('skips rather than upserts a segment opened after suppression', async () => {\n      const h = harness([SUPPRESS, text('hidden'), STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual(['upsert 0 user \"hello\"', 'skip 1', 'stream_end']);\n    });\n\n    it('still records a suppressed reply in the session, so history keeps it', async () => {\n      const h = harness([SUPPRESS, text('hidden'), STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      const {entries} = h.session;\n\n      expect(entries[1]).toMatchObject({role: 'assistant', content: 'hidden', isStreaming: false});\n    });\n\n    it('does not resurrect an entry the client only ever saw skipped', async () => {\n      const h = harness([SUPPRESS, text('hidden'), STOP, SUPPRESS]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames()).toEqual(['upsert 0 user \"hello\"', 'skip 1', 'stream_end']);\n    });\n\n    it('blanks each sent entry once, so a second suppression repeats nothing', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('leaked'), STOP, SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      expect(h.frames().filter(frame => frame === 'upsert 1 assistant \"\"')).toHaveLength(2);\n    });\n\n    it('marks a sent assistant entry it h.session.entries;\n      expect(answer).toMatchObject({role: 'assistant', content: 'leaked', suppressed: true});\n    });\n\n    it('marks a segment opened after suppression as suppressed in the 'assistant', content: 'hidden', suppressed: true});\n    });\n\n    it('leaves a thinking entry the client kept seeing unmarked, and marks the blanked answer', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('<thinking>private</thinking>said'), STOP, SUPPRESS]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      const [, thinking, answer] = h.session.entries;\n      expect({thinking: 'suppressed' in thinking, answer}).toMatchObject({\n        thinking: false,\n        answer: {role: 'assistant', content: 'said', suppressed: true},\n      });\n    });\n\n    it('commits and retracts an answer still open when suppression begins, and skips what follows as a new entry', async () => {\n      const h = harness([text('before'), SUPPRESS, text(' after'), STOP]);\n\n      await h.send();\n\n      const [, answer, after] = h.session.entries;\n      expect({frames: h.frames(), answer, after}).toMatchObject({\n        frames: [\n          'upsert 0 user \"hello\"',\n          'upsert 1 assistant \"\"',\n          'delta 1 \"before\"',\n          'commit 1',\n          'upsert 1 assistant \"\"',\n          'skip 2',\n          'stream_end',\n        ],\n        answer: {role: 'assistant', content: 'before', isStreaming: false, suppressed: true},\n        after: {role: 'assistant', content: ' after', suppressed: true},\n      });\n    });\n\n    it('commits a thought still open when 'upsert 0 user \"hello\"',\n          'upsert 1 thinking \"\"',\n          'delta 1 \"early\"',\n          'commit 1',\n          'skip 2',\n          'stream_end',\n        ],\n        thought: {role: 'thinking', content: 'early', isStreaming: false},\n        marked: false,\n        after: {role: 'thinking', content: ' later', suppressed: true},\n      });\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('failures', () => {\n    it('tells the client to retry when the provider is rate limited', async () => {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line re-lint/no-flag-params -- AIError's retryable flag; lone ping is answered now and a throw stays a rejection.\n58\tfunction answerOffTurn(\n59\t  ws: WebSocket,\n60\t  session: ChatSession,\n61\t  sessionStore: SessionStore,\n62\t  validation: next;\n68\t}\n69\t\n70\t// The whole answer, an error and the stream_end included, goes out inside the lock: an error frame names no message.\n71\tasync function answerInTurn(\n72\t  ws: WebSocket,\n73\t  session: ChatSession,\n74\t  orchestrator: ChatOrchestrator,\n75\t  sessionStore: SessionStore,\n76\t  validation: ValidationResult,\n77\t  signal: AbortSignal | undefined\n78\t): const startedAt = Date.now();\n85\t  try {\n86\t    await wsErrorHandler(ws, () => answerUserMessage(ws, session, orchestrator, sessionStore, validation, signal));\n87\t  } finally {\n88\t signal: AbortSignal | undefined\n111\t): Promise<void> {\n112\t  const message = validation.valid ? validation.data : undefined;\n113\t  if (message?.type === 'user_message') return validation: ValidationResult\n123\t): Promise<void> {\n124\t  if (!validation.valid) {\n125\t    log.warn('message', 'validation failed', {error: validation.error});\n126\t    sendError(ws, message.timestamp);\n132\t  if (message.type === 'list_sessions') await answerSessionList(ws, session, sessionStore, message);\n133\t}\n134\t\n135\t// The list is always the connection's own: the user id comes off the socket, and a userId on the frame is never read.\n136\tasync function answerSessionList(\n137\t  ws: WebSocket,\n138\t  session: ChatSession,\n139\t  sessionStore: validateMessage(rawMessage);\n    // Queued with no await before it, so a session's user_messages, a failed one too, are answered in arrival order.\n    if (isUserMessageFrame(rawMessage)) {\n      return lock.run(session.sessionId, () => answerInTurn(ws, session, orchestrator, validation, signal));\n    }\n    return answerOffTurn(ws, session, sessionStore, validation);\n  };\n}\n\n// One answer at a time per socket, in arrival order: a pong must never overtake the list the frame before it asked for.\nconst answered = new WeakMap<WebSocket, Promise<void>>();\n\n// An async action runs up to its first await at once, so a lone ping is answered now and a throw stays a rejection.\nfunction answerOffTurn(\n  ws: WebSocket,\n  session: ChatSession,\n  sessionStore: SessionStore,\n  validation: ValidationResult\n): Promise<void> {\n  const pending = answered.get(ws) ?? Promise.resolve();\n  const next = pending.then(() => wsErrorHandler(ws, () => answerFrame(ws, session, sessionStore, validation)));\n  answered.set(ws, next);\n  return next;\n}\n\n// The whole answer, an error and the stream_end included, goes out inside the lock: an error frame names no message.\nasync function answerInTurn(\n  ws: WebSocket,\n  session: ChatSession,\n  orchestrator: ChatOrchestrator,\n  sessionStore: SessionStore,\n  validation: ValidationResult,\n  signal: AbortSignal | undefined\n): Promise<void> {\n  // Its socket closed while it waited: nobody is left to read the answer, and a session's last close took its credentials.\n  if (signal?.aborted || ws.readyState === WebSocket.CLOSING || ws.readyState === WebSocket.CLOSED) {\n    log.info('message', 'queued message dropped: its socket closed', {sessionId: session.sessionId});\n    return;\n  }\n  const startedAt = Date.now();\n  try {\n    await wsErrorHandler(ws, () => answerUserMessage(ws, session, orchestrator, sessionStore, validation, signal));\n  } finally {\n    endTurn(ws, session, signal, startedAt);\n  }\n}\n\n// A turn whose socket closed is abandoned rather than ended: nobody is left to read a terminal frame.\nfunction endTurn(ws: WebSocket, session: ChatSession, signal: AbortSignal | undefined, startedAt: number): void {\n  if (signal?.aborted) {\n    log.info('message', 'turn abandoned: its socket closed', {\n      sessionId: session.sessionId,\n      elapsedMs: Date.now() - startedAt,\n    });\n    return;\n  }\n  sendStreamEnd(ws);\n}\n\nasync function answerUserMessage(\n  ws: WebSocket,\n  session: ChatSession,\n  orchestrator: ChatOrchestrator,\n  sessionStore: SessionStore,\n  validation: ValidationResult,\n  signal: AbortSignal | undefined\n): Promise<void> {\n  const message = validation.valid ? validation.data : undefined;\n  if (message?.type === 'user_message') return handleUserMessage(ws, session, orchestrator, message.content, signal);\n  return answerFrame(ws, session, sessionStore, validation);\n}\n\n// Off the lock, beside ping: a history request is not a turn and must not queue behind a streaming answer.\nasync function answerFrame(\n  ws: WebSocket,\n  session: ChatSession,\n  sessionStore: SessionStore,\n  validation: ValidationResult\n): Promise<void> {\n  if (!validation.valid) {\n    log.warn('message', 'validation failed', {error: validation.error});\n    sendError(ws, ErrorCodes.INVALID_MESSAGE, validation.error);\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const message = validation.data;\n  if (message.type === 'ping') handlePing(ws, message.timestamp);\n  if (message.type === 'list_sessions') await answerSessionList(ws, session, sessionStore, message);\n}\n\n// The list is always the connection's own: the user id comes off the socket, and a userId on the frame is never read.\nasync function answerSessionList(\n  ws: WebSocket,\n  session: ChatSession,\n  sessionStore: SessionStore,\n  message: ListSessionsMessage\n): Promise<void> {\n  // A store that cannot list answers nothing rather than an empty history: what to show the user is the client's call.\n  if (!sessionStore.listFor) {\n    sendJson(ws, {type: 'session_list', sessions: []});\n    return;\n  }\n  try {\n    const listed = await sessionStore.listFor((ws as ExtWebSocket).userId, {\n      limit: message.limit,\n      before: message.before,\n    });\n    sendJson(ws, {\n      type: 'session_list',\n      sessions: listed.map(summary => ({\n        sessionId: summary.sessionId,\n        createdAt: summary.createdAt.toISOString(),\n        updatedAt: summary.updatedAt.toISOString(),\n        entryCount: summary.entryCount,\n      })),\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    // The detail stays here: a frame that names the store's failure hands a client an internals leak.\n    log.error('ws', 'conversation list failed', {\n      sessionId: session.sessionId,\n      userId: (ws as ExtWebSocket).userId,\n      error: messageOf(error),\n    });\n    sendError(ws, ErrorCodes.SERVER_ERROR, 'Could not list conversations');\n  }\n}\n\n// Read from the raw frame, so a user_message that fails validation still gets its stream_end.\nfunction isUserMessageFrame(rawMessage: unknown): boolean {\n  return typeof rawMessage === 'object' && rawMessage !== null && Reflect.get(rawMessage, 'type') === 'user_message';\n}\n\nasync function wsErrorHandler(ws: WebSocket, action: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {\n  try {\n    await action();\n  } catch (error) server itself beside the URL a client should open. */\nexport async function startEngineWith(\n  options: Partial<HalServerOptions> & Pick<HalServerOptions, 'sessionStore'>\n): Promise<{url: string; hal: HalServer}> {\n  const hal = createServer({\n    app: (() => undefined) as unknown as Express,\n    wsAuth: async () => ({id: 'u1'}),\n    orchestrator: answeringOrchestrator,\n    ...options,\n  });\n  await hal.start(0);\n  servers.push(hal);\n  const {port} = hal.server.address() as AddressInfo;\n  return {url: `ws://127.0.0.1:${port}/hal/ws/c1`, hal};\n}\n\n/** Opens a client that the suite's teardown will close, whether its test passed or failed. */\nexport function connectClient(url: string, token = 't'): WebSocket {\n  const client = new WebSocket(url, [HAL_WS_SUBPROTOCOL, token]);\n  clients.push(client);\n  return client;\n}\n\n/** A promise a test settles by hand, to hold a stream or a hook at a point of its choosing. */\nexport function deferred(): {until: Resolves with every frame type seen up to and including the first `until` frame. */\nexport function framesUntil(client: WebSocket, until: string): Promise<string[]> {\n  const seen: string[] = [];\n  return new Promise<string[]>(resolve => {\n    client.on('message', raw => {\n      const {type} = JSON.parse(String(raw)) as {type: string};\n      seen.push(type);\n      if (type === until) resolve(seen);\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/** Opens a client that asks one question the moment the socket opens, resolving on the first `until` frame. */\nexport function askOnOpen(\n  url: string,\n  {until = 'stream_end', token}: {until?: string; token?: string} = {}\n): {client: WebSocket; finished: Promise<string[]>} {\n  const client = connectClient(url, token);\n  const finished =
